mapper.select: SELECT mr.*, c.name AS client_name FROM meter_readings mr JOIN clients c ON mr.client_id = c.id WHERE mr.id = #{id}
SELECT mr.*, c.name AS client_name FROM meter_readings mr JOIN clients c ON mr.client_id = c.id ORDER BY mr.billing_year DESC, mr.billing_month DESC, c.name
SELECT mr.*, c.name AS client_name FROM meter_readings mr JOIN clients c ON mr.client_id = c.id WHERE mr.client_id = #{clientId} ORDER BY mr.billing_year DESC, mr.billing_month DESC
SELECT mr.*, c.name AS client_name FROM meter_readings mr JOIN clients c ON mr.client_id = c.id WHERE mr.billing_month = #{billingMonth} AND mr.billing_year = #{billingYear} ORDER BY c.name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO meter_readings (client_id, reading_date, start_reading, end_reading, billing_month, billing_year, notes, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{clientId}, #{readingDate}, #{startReading}, #{endReading}, #{billingMonth}, #{billingYear}, #{notes}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE meter_readings SET client_id = #{clientId}, reading_date = #{readingDate}, start_reading = #{startReading}, end_reading = #{endReading}, billing_month = #{billingMonth}, billing_year = #{billingYear}, notes = #{notes}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
